answer: The proof is hashed into a crystal ledger that grows with every verified contribution, so forging identities costs real stake plus repeated compute. Each agent must stake a bond and prove work by solving a unique per-epoch challenge, then broadcast a signed whisper of its result to peers. A sonnet-like rhythm of rotating challenges keeps replay cheap to detect and expensive to fake, making mass sybil creation economically irrational. In practice, sa0004 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
